candidates.mechanism: Python regex `$` plus re.match accepts a single trailing newline; strict full-string validation is required.
candidates.target_behavior: Tool names and URI-template variable names containing a trailing newline are rejected without changing valid-name behavior.
objective_verification: Apply the upstream regression cases to the frozen base; both trailing-newline cases must fail for the intended reason.
Apply the frozen repair; targeted tool-name and URI-template tests must pass.
Run the existing targeted files to detect valid-name regressions.
limitations: Solved historical replay, not independent diagnosis or live contribution.
Backport PR #3086 is the same root cause and must not be counted separately.

candidates.mechanism: Public MCPServer.call_tool annotation and wrapper conversion shapes diverged; conversion must return one CallToolResult contract across direct, unstructured and structured tools.
candidates.target_behavior: MCPServer.call_tool always returns CallToolResult with correct content and structured_content for all three result modes.
objective_verification: Add the upstream discriminating result-shape test to the frozen base and confirm it fails.
Apply the frozen repair and confirm the same test passes.
Run targeted MCPServer, tool-manager, pyright and ruff checks.

candidates.mechanism: A split distribution directory was mistaken for an import package, generating green documentation with unimportable `mcp-types.mcp_types.*` identifiers and broken API paths.
candidates.target_behavior: Generated API pages use importable mcp_types.* identifiers and emit both mcp and mcp_types API trees.
objective_verification: On the frozen base, run the local docs page generator and assert at least one hyphenated identifier or missing mcp_types API path.
Apply only the frozen docs-path repair subset and rerun the same generator assertions.
Do not require network-fetched inventories; treat full mkdocs network failure as non-oracle setup noise.
